3D Light.description:
Provides a point-light configuration to the Equirectangular Pipeline.

**Position and appearance**

**[ Light Pos X]** Light position along the scene X axis.

**[ Light Pos Y]** Light position along the scene Y axis.

**[ Light Pos Z]** Light position along the scene Z axis.

**[ Light Color]** Light color used by the pipeline's diffuse and specular shading.

**[ Light Near Dist]** Distance at which attenuation starts. Inside this distance the light has full strength.

**[ Light Far Dist]** Distance at which light falls to zero. 0 disables attenuation for unlimited range.

**[ Light Falloff]** Exponent shaping the attenuation curve between the near and far distances.

**[ Light Intensity]** Multiplier for the light's diffuse and specular contribution.

**Output**

**[ Light Out]** Reference to this light. Connect it to a Light input of the Equirectangular Pipeline.

**Notes**

This node supplies data and does not draw by itself. Use scene units for position and distances. When attenuation is enabled, keep Light Far Dist greater than Light Near Dist.

Black Holes.description:
Simulates two mutually attracting bodies and derives position, speed, distance and proximity-based temperature signals.

**Simulation controls**

**[ G]** Strength of gravitational attraction.

**[ Energy Loss]** Velocity retained after each frame: 1 keeps all velocity; smaller values add damping.

**[ Mass BH1]** Mass of body 1, applied during simulation.

**[ Mass BH2]** Mass of body 2, applied during simulation.

**[ Time Factor]** Multiplier for the number of integration iterations per update.

**[ RK4 Steps Base]** Base iteration count. Iterations per update are rounded Time Factor times this count, with a minimum of one.

**[ Min Distance]** Minimum separation used in the force denominator, in simulation units; limits close-range acceleration.

**[ Zoom In]** Magnifies output positions about the current center of mass.

**[ Reset]** Restarts the simulation using the current initial-position and initial-velocity controls; clears merge and temperature state.

**[ Merge!]** Freezes the simulation on the next update, centers both position outputs at 0.5 and sets speeds to 0 until Reset.

**Initial conditions**

**[ Pos X BH1]** Initial normalized X position of body 1. Applied on Reset.

**[ Pos Y BH1]** Initial normalized Y position of body 1. Applied on Reset.

**[ Pos X BH2]** Initial normalized X position of body 2. Applied on Reset.

**[ Pos Y BH2]** Initial normalized Y position of body 2. Applied on Reset.

**[ BH1 X iniVel]** Initial horizontal velocity of body 1. Applied on Reset.

**[ BH1 Y iniVel]** Initial vertical velocity of body 1. Applied on Reset.

**[ BH2 X iniVel]** Initial horizontal velocity of body 2. Applied on Reset.

**[ BH2 Y iniVel]** Initial vertical velocity of body 2. Applied on Reset.

**Temperature controls**

**[ Temp Response]** Balances response rates. Below 0.5 slows cooling; above 0.5 slows heating.

**[ Temp Sensitivity]** Distance scale for the temperature target. Larger values keep temperature higher at the same separation.

**[ Temperature Threshold]** Reserved control. The current implementation does not use it to trigger merging or change the outputs.

**Outputs**

**[ BH1 X]** Body-1 X position relative to the center of mass, zoomed, centered at 0.5 and clamped to 0-1.

**[ BH1 Y]** Body-1 Y position relative to the center of mass, zoomed, centered at 0.5 and clamped to 0-1.

**[ BH2 X]** Body-2 X position relative to the center of mass, zoomed, centered at 0.5 and clamped to 0-1.

**[ BH2 Y]** Body-2 Y position relative to the center of mass, zoomed, centered at 0.5 and clamped to 0-1.

**[ BH1 Speed]** Magnitude of body-1 velocity in simulation units.

**[ BH2 Speed]** Magnitude of body-2 velocity in simulation units.

**[ Temperature]** Smoothed 0-1 proximity signal. Closer bodies give a higher target temperature.

**[ Distance]** Body separation divided by 1000 and clamped to 0-1.

**Notes**

Uses fixed 0.01 integration steps and advances on node updates rather than elapsed real time. Increasing the iteration count also advances more simulated time. Merge! is a manual input trigger, not an automatic merge notification.

Bounding Box Aspect Ratio.description:
Finds the bounding rectangle of paired 2D points and reports its size, aspect ratio and corners.

**[ X]** X coordinates of the points. Paired with Y by index.

**[ Y]** Y coordinates of the points. Paired with X by index.

**[ DoRotate]** Off finds an axis-aligned rectangle. On finds a minimum-area oriented rectangle using the convex hull; input points are not rotated.

**Outputs**

**[ AspectRatio]** Width divided by Height. Zero height with nonzero width gives FLT_MAX; a single location gives 1.

**[ Width]** Rectangle width in input coordinate units.

**[ Height]** Rectangle height in input coordinate units.

**[ AR_X]** Copy of the rectangle width, useful as an X scaling factor.

**[ AR_Y]** Copy of the rectangle height, useful as a Y scaling factor.

**[ BoxX]** Five X corner values, repeating the first corner to close the rectangle.

**[ BoxY]** Five Y corner values, repeating the first corner to close the rectangle.

**Notes**

Uses the shared input length and ignores pairs containing non-finite values. -1 is treated as a coordinate, not a separator. No valid points gives zero dimensions and corners, with aspect ratio 1. Recalculates on X or DoRotate changes; publish Y before X.

Buffer.description:
Stores a bounded history of Input values for a Header or HeaderPro of the same type. A new sample is recorded when Input changes while Rec is on. Input changes during preset loading are not recorded, so temporary initialization values do not enter the history.

Rec -> Enables recording.
Timestamp -> If connected, supplies each sample's timestamp; otherwise the current wall clock time is used.
Max Size -> Maximum number of stored samples. Older samples are discarded as new ones arrive.
Clear -> Empties the history.
Output -> The Buffer connection for a Header or HeaderPro; it is not the latest sample value.
Inspector: Last Frame Ms -> Available time span in milliseconds backward from the newest sample, updated when Input changes.
Inspector: Sync To Transport -> Off: samples are stamped with the wall clock, or the Timestamp input, in recording order. On: the history is indexed by transport time. A sample is recorded every frame while the transport plays and whenever Input changes; the Timestamp input is ignored. Recording replaces what was stored over the time just played, so loops and scrubbing refresh samples in place and never grow the buffer. Header reads are anchored at the playhead: after a seek into material played before they return the samples recorded for that time, samples ahead of the playhead are ignored, and a read with no sample within two frames of its time sets Overflow. A full buffer discards samples ahead of the playhead first, then the oldest. Switching this option empties the history.

Chaotic Attractor.description:
Generates a rolling history of a 3D chaotic trajectory and projects it to two coordinate vectors.

**Equation controls**

**[ Type]** Selects one of 17 built-in attractors. Changing it resets coefficients, recommended step size and trajectory.

**[ Use Preset IC]** Uses the selected attractor's stored initial conditions on Reset; off uses randomized initial conditions.

**[ Param 1]** First equation coefficient. Its visible name changes with Type: for example Sigma for Lorenz, alpha for Chua, or a for several other systems.

**[ Param 2]** Second equation coefficient. Its visible name changes with Type: for example Rho for Lorenz, beta for Chua, or b for several other systems.

**[ Param 3]** Third equation coefficient. Its visible name changes with Type: for example Beta for Lorenz, m0 for Chua, or c for several other systems. A slot labeled Unused has no adjustable role for that type.

**Simulation controls**

**[ Step Size]** Numerical integration step. Larger values advance more per step but can destabilize the trajectory. Type changes load a recommended value.

**[ Speed]** Integration work per update. 0 holds the trajectory. Fractional settings perform ceil(Speed) full steps plus one fractional step.

**[ Size]** Maximum number of trajectory samples retained in the output history.

**[ Reset]** Restarts from preset or random initial conditions, performs burn-in and clears trajectory history.

**Projection controls**

**[ Projection]** Selects the XY, XZ or YZ plane for the two outputs.

**[ Scale]** Magnifies coordinates around each attractor's statistical mean before clamping.

**[ Offset X]** Offset added to the normalized 3D X coordinate before projection.

**[ Offset Y]** Offset added to the normalized 3D Y coordinate before projection.

**[ Offset Z]** Offset added to the normalized 3D Z coordinate before projection.

**Outputs**

**[ Output X]** First coordinate of the selected projection, oldest to newest, clamped to 0-1.

**[ Output Y]** Second coordinate of the selected projection, oldest to newest, clamped to 0-1.

**Notes**

Coefficient entries describe the three physical control slots; their on-screen labels and ranges depend on Type. Size is a history limit, so outputs can be shorter while filling. Simulation speed depends on node update rate.

Equirectangular Pipeline.description:
Renders connected 3D meshes and lights into a 360-degree equirectangular texture viewed from the scene origin.

**Render controls**

**[ Resolution]** Output size selector: 0 = 2048 x 1024; 1 = 4096 x 2048; 2 = 8192 x 4096; 3 = 16384 x 8192. Larger sizes use substantially more GPU memory.

**[ BackColor]** Background color of the rendered scene.

**[ Wireframe?]** Enables wireframe overlays for every connected mesh.

**[ Ambient Light]** Strength of the ambient material contribution.

**[ Specular]** Strength of specular highlights.

**[ Shininess]** Specular exponent. Higher values make highlights tighter.

**Fog**

**[ Enable Fog]** Enables distance-based fog measured from the scene origin.

**[ Fog Color]** Color blended into distant geometry.

**[ Fog Near]** Scene distance where fog starts.

**[ Fog Far]** Scene distance where fog reaches full strength. Keep greater than Fog Near.

**[ Fog Power]** Exponent shaping fog progression between the near and far distances.

**Mesh slot parameters**

**[ Mesh_n]** Mesh reference for slot n, for example Mesh_0. Connect a primitive renderer's Mesh Out here.

**[ Opacity_n]** Opacity of mesh slot n, from 0 to 1.

**[ DepthW_ n]** Allows slot n to write to the depth buffer. Initial slots include a space after the underscore; added slots use DepthW_n.

**[ RenderOrd_ n]** Draw-order value for slot n. Lower values draw first. Initial slots include a space after the underscore; added slots use RenderOrd_n.

**[ CapQApex_n]** Projective texture-coordinate weight at a cap or pole center for slot n. Adjusts how cap textures converge.

**[ CapMaxRadius_n]** Radius used to normalize cap texture mapping for slot n, in scene units.

**[ SelfIllum_n]** Bypasses lighting for slot n so its base texture color is used directly; fog can still apply.

**[ Wireframe_n]** Enables a wireframe overlay for mesh slot n, independently of the global toggle.

**[ WirefColor_n]** Wireframe overlay color for mesh slot n.

**Light slot parameter**

**[ Light_n]** Light reference for slot n, for example Light_0. Connect a 3D Light node's Light Out here.

**Output**

**[ Tex.Out]** Rendered 2:1 equirectangular texture, with longitude across its width and latitude across its height.

**Inspector**

**[ Num Meshes]** Number of independently configured mesh slots.

**[ Num Lights]** Number of light input slots; can be 0.

**Notes**

n denotes one zero-based slot index, not a vector control. Each slot gets its own separately named parameters. Resolution controls the six cubemap faces used for capture as well as the final output. Transparent layers may need deliberate render order and depth-write settings.

Euclidean Generator.description: Generates evenly distributed rhythmic onsets with divisions and offset, outputting values, gates and indices.

Euclidean MST.description: Builds a minimum spanning tree connecting input XY points, starting from a chosen node.

Euclidean Patterns.description: Generates Euclidean rhythmic patterns for each output sequence, distributing onsets evenly across a defined length with optional offset control. Additionally, accents can be applied to the onsets using a secondary Euclidean pattern, with accent positions offset and accent strength customizable. Accented onsets have a value of 1, while non-accented onsets are modulated by the accent strength parameter.

Euclidean Ticks.description: Distributes rhythmic onsets evenly across a cycle and derives pulses and counts from an incoming tick count.

Euclidean Ticks Poly.description: Generates multiple Euclidean gate patterns from tick counts, with per-pattern lengths, onsets and offsets.

Event Counter.description: Counts the number of events that have reached the input. Outputs as a vector of integers, and a void tick for each new event.

Event Gate.description: Generates a one-frame vector trigger (1 → 0) when Input changes.

FORMS P5 PNG Director.description: Advanced probabilistic element sequencer with three-tier probability control and solo isolation. Global % gates all output, Group % controls category activation (rhythm/texture/harmony/fx), individual % selects elements within active groups. Solo button (S column) bypasses all probabilities to isolate single elements for testing. Load custom element files via Path/Open - elements auto-categorize by prefix (r/t/h/fx). Weight sliders generate biased random transpose/degree sequences. Move buttons (^) reorder elements while preserving all settings. Snapshots capture complete state including solo states, group assignments, and GUI configuration. Two-stage workflow: assign elements via dropdown menus, set probabilities, configure groups, then trigger GO for weighted string output.

FORMS->P5 OSC Sender.description: Sends Forms musical and visual control data to a host and port over OSC.

Fat Line.description: Renders XY lines with per-point width, color, alpha and overall opacity into a texture.

Fat Line 2.description: Builds thick-line geometry from point coordinates with per-point width and color controls.

Fat Line Renderer.description: Renders thick-line geometry into a texture with configurable dimensions.

Feedback FX.description: Applies video feedback with scale, mix amount and origin controls.

Filename Extractor.description: Extracts filename without extension from a full path.

Filter Duplicates.description: Removes duplicate values from an input vector.

Fit Notes In Range.description: Maps input notes to fit within a specified range while preserving pitch classes (note names). Notes outside the range are transposed to their enharmonic equivalent within the range.

Fixture.description: Maps configured lighting fixture parameters into DMX channel values for a universe and address.

Flip Flop.description: Toggles between 0 and 1 based on input triggers. Input '1' sets output to 1, input '0' sets output to 0, input '1-0' toggles between 1 and 0.

Float Filter.description: Filters input float values using a vector of indices.

Float to String.description: Converts a vector of floats to a string with a custom separator.

FloatToBool.description: Converts a float input into a boolean output.

FloatToVoid.description: Converts float input events into void triggers.

Flocking.description:
Moves a collection of boids toward a shared target and outputs their positions in a wrapping 0-1 square.

**Controls**

**[ Num Boids]** Number of moving points. Changing it regenerates all positions and velocities.

**[ Follow X]** Target X coordinate, from 0 to 1.

**[ Follow Y]** Target Y coordinate, from 0 to 1.

**[ Follow Strength]** Magnitude of the steering force toward the target before Max Force is applied.

**[ Max Speed]** Maximum movement distance per node update.

**[ Max Force]** Maximum steering acceleration per node update.

**Outputs**

**[ Out X]** One normalized X position per boid, in boid order.

**[ Out Y]** One normalized Y position per boid, in boid order.

**Notes**

The current implementation steers each boid toward the target independently; it does not calculate neighbor separation, alignment or cohesion. Motion is update-rate dependent. Points crossing an edge wrap to the opposite edge.

Fold.description: Folds values from input that exceed the high or low thresholds back into the threshold range, similar to audio wavefolding but for vectors of values. When a value exceeds the high threshold, it's reflected back down. When a value falls below the low threshold, it's reflected back up.

Follow Index to Moving Heads.description: Maps input indices and a distribution to left and right moving-head outputs.

Follow Point.description: Calculates moving-head pan and tilt angles to aim fixtures at input 3D points, with a positioning preview window.

Forms Scroller.description: Renders a phase-driven Forms scrolling view with musical grid, scale and header controls.

Forms Scroller Folder.description: Scrolls images from a selected folder using phase and outputs image and musical metadata.

Formula.description: Math formula evaluator with vector support. Edit the formula on the node. The Requesty AI assistant can generate a new formula or repair the current one. Formula files can be loaded from or saved to the data/formulas library. Use $i1, $i2... for automatically-created inputs and assign $o1, $o2... for outputs. Legacy $1, $2... input names and a final bare-expression output remain supported. Rename ports with identifier labels such as $i1.label=frequency; labels can then be used as port aliases. Supports +,-,*,/,%,^,( ), sin/cos/tan, atan2, sqrt, abs, pow, exp, log, min/max, clamp, step, smoothstep, floor/ceil/round. Vector functions: len(v), indices(v), at(v,i), sum(v), mean(v), min(v), max(v), median(v), rms(v), std(v), var(v), idxmin(v), idxmax(v), vec(...), repeat(x,n), concat(...), sort(v). Vector literals: [1,2,3]. Scalars broadcast over vectors. Conditional: if(cond,a,b). Variables: separate statements with ';' and assign with '=', e.g. "x = $i1 + $i2; $o1 = x * 100".

Fourier Shape.description: Converts an XY shape into Fourier frequency data.

Frame Gate.description: Passes or suppresses an input on a frame using a probability control.

Frame Inspector.description: Reports frame rate and dimensions of a video frame while passing it through.

Framerate Control.description: Controls the application framerate. Use the target FPS parameter to set the desired framerate, toggle to enable/disable framerate control, and monitor the actual FPS.

Frustrum Stars.description: Selects stars in the viewing frustum within a magnitude range.

Frustrum Stars Selector.description: Selects HIP star identifiers from the stars in the current viewing frustum.

Gamma Levels FX.description: Adjusts video frame minimum level, maximum level and gamma.

Gate Duration.description: Extends gate signals for a specified duration in milliseconds. When an input gate transitions from 0 to 1, the output gate will remain at 1 for the duration specified in TimeMs.

Gator FX.description: Gates video frames to black or white at a BPM-controlled frequency.

Gene Table.description: Loads a gene table file and outputs the table data.

Generative Grid.description: Generates vector graphics in a grid layout with various shape types per cell. CellShape values: 0=empty, 1=left line, 2=left+right lines, 3=top line, 4=top+bottom lines, 5=diagonal TL-BR, 6=diagonal TR-BL, 7=diagonal cross, 8-11=triangles, 12=rectangle, 13=ellipse. ShapeSizeX/Y control independent horizontal/vertical scaling.

Generative Grid 2.description: Generates vector graphics in an irregular grid defined by vertex points. GridX/GridY define the intersection points of grid lines. Click cells in GUI to select them. Shape types: 0=cross, 1=diagonal cross, 2=ellipse, 3=dot, 4=central horizontal, 5=central vertical. Per-cell control of shapeType, opacity, scale (centered), and color.

Get ASTRES Ctrler Data.description: Reads the ASTRES controller pan, tilt, roll and field of view.

Global Snapshots.description: Global snapshot system that captures all parameters in the current canvas. Shift+click to store, click to recall.

Globals.description: Exposes globally stored variables from the selected category.

Graaf Delaunay.description: Creates Delaunay Graaf from input vertices.

Graaf Info.description: Extracts information from a Graaf graph

Graaf MST.description: Computes Minimum Spanning Tree from input graph using Prim's algorithm

Graaf Simple Tree Traverse.description: Traverses a tree structure (growth) and ‘degrows’ it from the root outward.

Graaf Spanning Trees.description: Generates all possible spanning trees from input graph

Graaf Tree Info.description: Extracts information from a Graaf tree

Gradient.description: Generates a color gradient texture from configurable color stops.

Gradient2.description: Generates a gradient texture with configurable colors and stop positions.

HSV to RGB.description: Converts HSV (all normalized 0-1) to RGB (0-1). Inputs can be single values or vectors.

HalfTone FX.description: Applies a halftone effect to video frames with color steps, scale, blur and time controls.

Harmonic Partials.description: Generates harmonic or subharmonic numbers from a root. Input is a vector of harmonic indices; output is root * n or root / n depending on the selected mode. If Root = 1, the output are pure ratios.

Harmonic Series.description: Generates a selectable range of harmonic or subharmonic series for given pitches. Pow redistributes the selected partials toward the low or high end of the range. Offers different shapes for amplitude distributions across the harmonic series, as well a simulation of LP and HP filtering.

Harmony Detector.description: Detects chords and scales from incoming pitch values. Converts pitches to pitch classes (mod 12), finds root note, and identifies chord/scale quality. Reads definitions from chords.txt and scales.txt files.

Header.description:
Reads samples from a connected Buffer and sends them as a vector.

Buffer Input -> Connect the Output of a Buffer of the same type.
Copies -> Number of samples to read.
Offset -> With one copy, the distance from the newest sample. With multiple copies and one Offset value, the spacing between samples: the reads start at 0, then 1, 2, and so on times that value. Supply exactly one Offset per copy to choose each distance separately.
Output -> Samples in Offset order.
Overflow -> True when a millisecond delay exceeds the available timestamp history, or a sample index exceeds the oldest sample. An out-of-range read returns the oldest available sample. Zero milliseconds reads the newest sample without overflow.

Inspector: Offset as Position -> Off: Offset is a delay in milliseconds from the newest stored timestamp; the nearest stored sample is used. On: Offset is a sample index back from the newest sample, with 0 being the newest and fractional positions rounded down.
Inspector: Calculate On Update -> On: refresh Output every update and when the Buffer records a sample. Off: refresh only when Copies, Offset, or Buffer Input changes. New samples in the same Buffer do not trigger a refresh in this mode.

HeaderPro.description:
Reads samples from a connected Buffer and sends them as a vector.

Buffer Input -> Connect the Output of a Buffer of the same type.
Copies -> Number of samples to read.
Offset Mode -> Frames: sample index back from newest (0 is newest; fractions round down). Ms: milliseconds back from the newest timestamp, using the nearest sample. Normalized: position across the stored samples (0 is newest, 1 is oldest).
Offset -> With one copy, the requested position in the selected mode. With multiple copies and one Offset value, reads at 0, 1, 2, and so on times that value. Supply one Offset per copy for individual positions.
Output -> Samples in Offset order.
Overflow -> True when a Frames or Normalized position exceeds the oldest sample, or a requested Ms delay exceeds the available timestamp history, including when Fit Available History compresses the reads. Without fitting, an out-of-range read returns the oldest available sample. Zero Ms reads the newest sample without overflow.

Inspector: Fit Available History -> Off by default. In Ms mode, proportionally compress all requested delays when the largest exceeds the recorded time span. Their relative spacing is preserved as history grows; original delays are used once enough history exists. An empty or disconnected Buffer produces an empty Output and Overflow is true. With one sample, all copies read that sample. Frames and Normalized modes are unchanged.
Inspector: Calculate On Update -> On: refresh Output every update and when the Buffer records a sample. Off: refresh only when Copies, Offset, Offset Mode, Fit Available History, or Buffer Input changes. New samples in the same Buffer do not trigger a refresh in this mode.

Heliostat Debug.description: Queries heliostat status, calibration, position and errors over OSC.

Heliostat OSC.description: Sends heliostat angle, speed, acceleration and laser intensity commands over OSC.

Histogram.description: Builds a histogram of input values with configurable bins, range and update speed.

Histogram 2.description:
Multi-lane scrolling waveform display with multiple input support.
New data appears on the right, scrolls left over time.
Multiple inputs are overlaid with progressive transparency.

Histogram Score.description:
Scrolling waveform rendered into a texture with transparent background.
Each vector element draws an independent lane.
In Pitch Mode, input = MIDI pitch; Min/Max define the pitch range.
PitxText draws note names (C4, Eb3…) at note onsets (thickness 0→nonzero).

Histogram Vector.description:
Scrolling spectrogram-style histogram for a float vector input.
Every incoming vector becomes a new right-side column and the history scrolls left.
Element 0 is rendered at the bottom, like the low band of a classic spectrogram.

ILDA Debugger.description: Displays laser point coordinates and RGB channels for inspecting ILDA data.

ILDA Projector.description: Sends laser frames to an ILDA projector with intensity, scan speed, offset and blanking controls.

ILDA Shape.description: Converts vector graphics into an ILDA laser shape, with black level and threshold controls.

Ignore Zeros.description: When an input value is zero, outputs the previous non-zero value instead. Each vector index maintains its own history.

Image File.description: Loads an image as a Playmodes frame with rotation, flip and opacity controls.

Image Loader.description: Loads an image file and outputs its texture.

Image Manager.description: Loads images from any file path, displays them as texture output, and allows saving copies to disk.

Increment.description: Increments or decrements a value by a step amount. Output resets to input value when input changes.

Index Highlight.description: Highlights specific indices of an input vector based on the 'highlight' input.

Index Monitor.description: Outputs the indices of input vector elements that are different from zero

Index Router.description: Routes input values to specified output indices. Output size is determined by the maximum index value + 1. Missing indices are filled with 0 or -1.

Indexer.description: Creates a distributed vector of indices

Indexer Texture.description: Generates a texture of distributed indices with symmetry, offset, quantization and modulo controls.

Indexer Texture 2.description: Generates a two-dimensional index texture with radial and angular resolution controls.

Inject Alpha.description: Replaces or modulates a texture alpha channel using another texture.

Input Processing.description: Processes video frames with threshold, smoothing, spatial and gamma controls.

Int Slider.description: A slider with transparent background, bindable to int portals.

Int Value.description: A numeric input field that connects to an int portal.

Interactive Canvas.description: Displays a texture and outputs interactive pointer coordinates and force.

Interval Ratios.description: Outputs frequency ratios for musical intervals. Can work in Just Intonation or 12-TET. Useful as a Step source for progression nodes.

Inv Fourirer Shape.description: Reconstructs an XY shape from frequency data and phase.

Jazz Standards.description: Browses jazz standards and outputs song metadata, chords, section durations and repeats.

Jazz Walk.description: Jazz-style melodic random walk with harmonic awareness, phrase shaping, expressive dynamics, motif repetition, trills, and tremolos.

Just Intonation Adapter.description: Converts 12-TET semitone offsets into 'just-corrected' semitones. Input is a vector of semitones (e.g. 0,4,7). Output is a vector of floats such that 2^(out/12) follows the selected tuning system (5-limit, 7-limit, 11-limit, Pythagorean, Custom, or NearestHarmonic).

Just Intonation Chords.description: Builds chords by stacking an arbitrary semitone-step pattern on top of a root. The Step parameter is a vector (e.g. {3,4} for a minor-like stack, {5} for quartal, {7} for quintal). Length controls how many notes are generated. Supports Just Intonation and 12-TET.

Kaleidoscope FX.description: Applies a kaleidoscope effect to video frames with side count, angle, rotation and slide controls.

Keystroke.description: Fires a void trigger on 'Output' when the key pressed matches the 'Key' parameter. 'Last Key' outputs the name of the last pressed key. When 'Combo' is on, 'Key' accepts modifier+key combinations like cmd+space or ctrl+shift+a.

LFO Track.description: Outputs the LFO clips of a timeline track. Value is the LFO as drawn (0..1), Phase the raw 0..1 ramp, Cycle the whole cycles since the timeline start (continuous across clips and repeats) and Reset fires on each wrap during playback. Connect Phase -> Phase and Cycle -> Step of random nodes in Sync To Transport mode for results that are identical when scrubbing.

Laser Simulator.description: Previews laser projection in a 3D scene with field of view, floor and camera controls.

Limit Polyphony.description: Limits the number of active values or voices to a configurable maximum.

Lineal.Structures.description: Finds stars inside and outside a line region defined by angle and width.

Lissajous.description: Displays SuperCollider audio channels as an XY Lissajous scope with time window, gain and trail controls.

Load Vectors From File.description:
Loads numeric CSV data and creates a separate float-vector outlet for each non-empty numeric row.

**Control**

**[ Open File]** Opens a file chooser. The selected CSV is read on the next update.

**Outputs**

**[ File Path]** Selected file path. Files inside the application data folder are stored with a relative path.

**[ row_ n]** One outlet for CSV row n, starting at 0. The visible name contains a space after the underscore, for example row_ 0.

**Notes**

Numeric cells are parsed as floats. Invalid or out-of-range cells are skipped; rows containing no parsed numbers are omitted. Output count follows the loaded rows, so it is not known before loading a file. Relative paths resolve against the application data folder.

Logic.description: Applies a selected logic operation to two inputs.

Looper FX.description: Records and loops video frames with beat timing, gate, speed, offset and refresh controls.

LumaKey FX.description: Applies a luminance key to video frames using threshold and smoothing.

MF34 Liceu.description:
Turns MagicForce MF34 keypad events into numbered cues. Connect USB Keyboard's Key Code output to Key Code In.

**Input**

**[ Key Code In]** USB HID code. Keypad digits accumulate a number; code 58 confirms it, 41 clears typing, and 80 steps back one cue.

**Outputs**

**[ Accum.]** Digits currently being typed, as text. Clears after confirmation, clear or step-back.

**[ Number Out]** Last confirmed cue number. Confirm with no digits advances it by one; step-back subtracts one.

**[ Number Trigger]** Fires whenever a cue is confirmed, advanced or stepped back, including repeated cue numbers.

**Notes**

Uses the project-specific keyboard mapping: confirmation is HID code 58, not the standard Return code. Keypad codes 89-97 map to 1-9; code 98 maps to 0.

MIDI Clock.description: Reads an external MIDI clock (ticks, Start/Stop/Continue, Song Position) and outputs its play state, triggers, beat position (stepped and smooth), 24 PPQ position and tempo. Drive Transport makes it the clock of the global transport (like Sync: MIDI Clock).

MIDI Clock Out.description: Sends MIDI clock and transport messages from PPQ ticks, play and reset inputs.

MIDI Clock Transport.description: Receives MIDI clock and transport messages and outputs BPM, beats, PPQ ticks and playback state.

MIDI Keyboard Emulator.description: Turns the computer keyboard into a polyphonic MIDI-style keyboard. Use A-L (plus ; and ') for white keys and W/E/T/Y/U/O/P for black keys. Z and X move the octave down and up. Pitch[] and Gate[] contain one voice per simultaneously held note.

MIDI Note Quantizer.description: Quantizes note pitch and gate events to a transport grid, optionally quantizing note-off events.

Macro.description: Groups nodes in a nested canvas. Routers expose inputs and outputs to the parent canvas; snapshots store macro states.

Macro Active?.description:
Reports node activation and sends a trigger after activation, useful inside macros.

**Outputs**

**[ Activated?]** True after activate() and false after deactivate(). Reflects the node lifecycle, rather than checking a macro name.

**[ Trigger Void]** Fires once on the next update after activation. Deactivation cancels a pending event.

**Notes**

Outputs are not stored in presets. Place the node inside a macro to react to that macro's activation lifecycle.

Manual Oscillator Bank.description: Generates phase-driven oscillations from manually specified values with damping controls.

Manual Points.description:
Interactive window opens where you can create points and drag them around a [0,0] to [1,1] space.
Right-Click to create or delete points.
Left-click to drag points.
Keyboard arrows move the selected point. (+alt moves very slowly).
TAB key switches between selected points.

Input is a texture to apply as background to the window area.

Manual Vector.description: Edits a vector manually with size, value range and fine adjustment controls.

Mapper.description: Simple map() function. Maps input range to output range

Markov Chain.description: Generates state transitions from a Markov chain driven by phase.

Markov Vector.description: Generates sequences based on Markov transition probabilities. Each slider row defines probabilities of moving from one state to others. The 'duplicates' vector defines how many times each state is repeated in output.

Matlab OSC Receiver.description: Receives laser coordinates and pointing commands from Matlab over OSC.

Matrix Display.description:
Displays a W×H grayscale matrix from a float vector input (0..1).
Supports both a floating window and an embedded node widget.

Melodic Mutation.description: Seed-based melodic sequencer with step-wise musical mutation. MelodySeed generates the base melody; MutSeed governs mutation flavour. Mutate/Demutate navigate a branching history applied at the next loop boundary.

Merge.description: Merges event values from various inputs

Merge Void.description: Merges void signals from various inputs into one output

Metab Points.description:
Generates an organism-like point cloud from delayed copies of a moving capital point, with per-point noise, vector offsets and radii.

**Point count and orbit**

**[ Num Points]** Number of delayed position samples to output, from 1 to 64.

**[ Circle Ph.]** Orbit phase in turns. Animate this input to move around the circle.

**[ Do Circles]** Orbit diameter; its radius is half this value.

**[ Offset]** Phase offset added to Circle Ph., in turns.

**Freedom movement**

**[ Freedom]** Amplitude of the capital point's seeded noise walk around 0.5.

**[ Freed. Speed]** Speed of the freedom noise clock. 0 holds its time.

**[ Freed. Quant]** Number of delay groups distributed across the output points.

**[ Seed X]** Seed coordinate used by both the freedom walk and per-point X noise.

**[ Seed Y]** Seed coordinate used by both the freedom walk and per-point Y noise.

**[ Reset Free.]** Restarts the freedom clock's counter. Its accumulated speed-continuity offset is retained.

**Per-point noise**

**[ Noise]** Amplitude of the independent noise added to each delayed point.

**[ Noise Scale]** Spread of noise coordinates across point indices; changes how similar adjacent points move.

**[ Noise Speed]** Speed of the per-point noise clock, also scaled by Noise Time Scale.

**[ Reset Noise]** Restarts the per-point noise counter. Its accumulated speed-continuity offset is retained.

**Position and delay**

**[ Pos X]** Horizontal offset of the capital point before multiplying by Pos Amount.

**[ Pos Y]** Vertical offset of the capital point before multiplying by Pos Amount.

**[ Pos Amount]** Amount of the Pos X and Pos Y offsets applied to the capital point.

**[ VecPos X]** Additional X offset for each output point, scaled by VPos Amount.

**[ VecPos Y]** Additional Y offset for each output point, scaled by VPos Amount.

**[ VPos Amount]** Multiplier for the per-point vector offsets.

**[ Delay Ms]** Scale of the point-delay ramp in milliseconds. Early points read older positions; late points read newer positions.

**Radius controls**

**[ Radius Min]** Radius assigned to a distribution value of 0.

**[ Radius Max]** Radius assigned to a distribution value of 1.

**[ Radius Distr.]** Values mapped from 0-1 into the radius range. A single value broadcasts to Num Points; a longer vector keeps its own length.

**Outputs**

**[ Cap 1 X]** Current X coordinate of the capital point before delay and per-point additions.

**[ Cap 1 Y]** Current Y coordinate of the capital point before delay and per-point additions.

**[ Pos X Out]** Generated X positions, one per point.

**[ Pos Y Out]** Generated Y positions, one per point.

**[ Radius Out]** Mapped radii for use by a metaball or circle generator.

**Inspector**

**[ Buffer Max Size]** Maximum history samples retained per coordinate delay line. One sample is recorded per update.

**[ Noise Time Scale]** Internal multiplier for the per-point noise clock. The macro-compatible default is 0.1.

**Notes**

Ported from METAB_POINTS_4. Uses Oceanode time. Delays exceeding available history are compressed proportionally; readings use the nearest recorded sample. Short VecPos inputs fall back to their first value, and empty inputs contribute 0. Outputs can extend beyond the 0-1 domain.

Metaballs.description:
Blends circular influence fields and traces their boundaries using marching squares.

**Inputs**

**[ Positions X]** X coordinate of each circle center in the normalized 0-1 domain.

**[ Positions Y]** Y coordinate of each circle center in the normalized 0-1 domain.

**[ Radii]** Radius of each circle in normalized coordinate units.

**Controls**

**[ Threshold]** Field value traced as the contour. Increasing it usually shrinks the visible blobs.

**[ Grid Resolution]** Number of grid samples per axis. Higher values improve contour detail and increase calculation cost.

**[ Smoothing]** Strength of contour smoothing. 0 leaves the traced vertices unchanged.

**Outputs**

**[ Num Circles]** Number of circle centers in Positions X. This is a reported count, not an input that creates circles.

**[ Contours X]** X coordinates of the resulting contour strips, separated by -1.

**[ Contours Y]** Y coordinates of the resulting contour strips, separated by -1.

**Notes**

Use matching coordinate and radius vector lengths; calculation uses their shared length. Setup extends short Y and radius vectors once, using their last value or a default, but later edits do not repeat this resize. A change to Positions Y alone does not recalculate; publish Y before X. Contours use paired -1 separators.

MetaballsV2.description:
Traces connected metaball contours with optional smoothing, loop closure and deliberate breaks across large vertex gaps.

**Inputs**

**[ Positions X]** X coordinate of each circle center in the normalized 0-1 domain.

**[ Positions Y]** Y coordinate of each circle center in the normalized 0-1 domain.

**[ Radii]** Radius of each circle in normalized coordinate units.

**Controls**

**[ Threshold]** Field value traced as the contour. Increasing it usually shrinks the visible blobs.

**[ Grid Resolution]** Number of grid samples per axis. Higher values improve contour detail and increase calculation cost.

**[ Smoothing]** Strength of contour smoothing. 0 leaves the traced vertices unchanged.

**[ Max Vertex Step]** Maximum allowed distance between consecutive output vertices. Larger gaps start a new strip; 0 disables this limit.

**[ Max Close Step]** Maximum allowed distance for the closing edge of a loop. 0 disables this limit.

**[ Close?]** Repeats the first vertex at the end of a genuine closed loop when its closing gap is allowed. Boundary-clipped contours remain open.

**Outputs**

**[ Contours X]** X coordinates of the resulting contour strips, separated by -1.

**[ Contours Y]** Y coordinates of the resulting contour strips, separated by -1.

**Notes**

Only the shared length of Positions X, Positions Y and Radii is used; this version does not broadcast short vectors. Inputs and controls recalculate on change. -1 in both contour outputs separates strips.

MetaballsV3.description:
Builds circular metaball contours using either additive fields or smooth unions of signed-distance shapes.

**Inputs**

**[ Positions X]** X coordinate of each circle center in the normalized 0-1 domain.

**[ Positions Y]** Y coordinate of each circle center in the normalized 0-1 domain.

**[ Radii]** Radius of each circle in normalized coordinate units.

**[ Strength]** Per-source amount: positive adds material, 0 disables the source, and negative carves it away. In SDF mode its absolute value scales radius.

**Mode and shape controls**

**[ Mode]** Additive sums influence fields. SDF Smooth Union joins circle distance fields.

**[ Falloff Power]** Rate at which a source's influence fades with distance. Applies in Additive mode.

**[ Threshold]** Field level traced in Additive mode. Higher values generally shrink the contours.

**[ Accumulation]** Additive overlap behavior: 0 uses the strongest source; 1 sums sources; intermediate values blend between them.

**[ Blend Distance]** Smooth-union blend width in SDF mode. Larger values make joins softer.

**[ SDF Offset]** Distance offset in SDF mode, used to expand or contract the shape.

**[ Border Margin]** Keeps the contours this far inside the normalized 0-1 square. A positive value closes contours at the border region.

**[ Border Feather]** Softens the shape near the domain edge. A positive value closes contours at the border region.

**[ Grid Resolution]** Sampling resolution per axis. Higher settings improve detail and increase computation cost.

**Outputs**

**[ Contours X]** X coordinates of the resulting contour strips, separated by -1.

**[ Contours Y]** Y coordinates of the resulting contour strips, separated by -1.

**Notes**

Single-value source vectors broadcast; longer mismatched vectors truncate to their shared length. Changes are batched and calculated once on update. Genuine loops close automatically; boundary-clipped contours stay open when border controls are zero. Use Wave It downstream for contour deformation.

Mirror Renderer.description: Mirrors and repeats video frame imagery using size, spacing, scale and inversion controls.

Mixer.description: Mixes multiple texture inputs with per-input opacity into a chosen output size.

Mixer 2Ch.description: Crossfades two Playmodes video frames with a selectable mix mode.

Mixer Alpha.description: Composites multiple textures with per-layer opacity and alpha handling.

Morph Osc Scope.description: Single-cycle MorphOSC waveform preview with the same shaping controls as the synthdef.

Morse Generator.description:
Plays text as timed Morse pulses. Trigger Play to encode the current text and begin from the start.

**Inputs and controls**

**[ Text]** Message to encode. Supported letters are case-insensitive; the built-in table also contains digits and punctuation.

**[ Unit Ms]** Duration of one timing unit in milliseconds. Dots last one unit and dashes three.

**[ Play]** Starts or restarts the current message.

**[ Reset]** Stops playback, clears Finished? and returns the message index to the start.

**Outputs**

**[ Output]** 1 during a dot or dash and 0 during gaps or after normal completion.

**[ Playing?]** True while the encoded message is being played.

**[ Finished?]** Becomes true after normal completion. Play or Reset clears it.

**Notes**

Uses Oceanode time and advances on node updates, so timing resolution depends on the update rate. Reset does not explicitly force Output to 0; stopping mid-pulse may leave its last value.

Movement Sim.description: Simulates movement toward an angle with speed and acceleration limits.

Movinghead Controller.description: Controls groups of moving-head fixtures with intensity, pan, tilt, color, focus, gobo and frost parameters.

Multi Gate Track.description: Edits and plays a timeline with multiple gate lanes and outputs gate and trigger vectors.

Multi Segments.description: Builds XY line segments from start and end coordinate vectors.

Multi Slider Matrix.description: A matrix of multiple sliders that output vector values. Each slider can be independently controlled and outputs its own vector.

Multi Toggle.description: Row of toggle buttons outputting a vector<float>. Each press sets output[i]=1, unpress sets 0. Tick Mode makes each press a one-frame pulse.

Multi Value Track.description: Creates a timeline track with multiple value lanes and outputs lane values and triggers during playback.

MultiSlider Grid.description: A customizable grid of sliders with quantization. Each slider value can be set interactively and outputs as a vector. The grid displays both slider positions and quantization steps. Multiple slots allow saving and recalling different patterns.

Multislider.description: A multislider with transparent background, bindable to vector<float> portals.

Multistate Vector.description: A vector-based node that allows the user to manipulate multiple pages of vector values. Each page can store a vector of values with customizable size, minimum, and maximum range. The current page can be selected, and the vector values can be edited in a custom graphical interface.

Multitoggle.description: A multitoggle with transparent background, bindable to vector<int> portals.

Multix FX.description: Composites multiple delayed video buffer frames with beat timing and per-copy opacity.

Multix3D FX.description: Composes multiple delayed video buffer frames with per-copy 3D transforms and opacity.

NDI Camera.description: Receives an NDI video stream as a texture with timestamps.

NDI Sender.description: Publishes an input texture as a named NDI video stream with readback and asynchronous send options.

Noise.description: Creates a Perlin noise based on a always changing input

Noise Texture.description: Generates a procedural noise texture with position, rotation, scale, warp and octave controls.

Note Gate.description: Sends MIDI note-on and note-off messages from pitch and gate inputs, with a panic control.

Note In.description: Receives MIDI notes on a selected channel and maps a note range to an output vector.

Note In Fast.description: Receives MIDI notes and outputs pitch, velocity and gate vectors with panic and note-range controls.

Note Matrix.description: Creates a multi-row step sequencer with variable subdivisions, driven by a phasor input

Note Out.description: Sends MIDI notes on a selected channel.

Number01.description: Sends a normalized [0..1] value every frame

Ocurrence.description: Outputs, for each input element, how many times that value occurs in the input vector.

OpenAI TTS.description: OpenAI speech synthesis. Run ofxOceanodeTTS/scripts/setup.py for this app's bin/data directory, then set OPENAI_API_KEY or add openai_api_key.txt beside the installed helper script.

Orbital Objects.description: Computes satellite orbital positions for an observer location and outputs object names, NORAD IDs, azimuth and elevation.

Order.description: Copies input vectors to four outputs in order, optionally queuing changes for frame-by-frame delivery.

Osc Sender.description: Sends configured parameter values as OSC messages to a host and port.

Oscillator.description: Calculates an oscillating signal based on a phase. Phase triggers the calculation. When no phase is connected, any other parameter triggers de calculation

Oscillator Texture.description: Generates a phase-driven oscillator texture using index values and waveform shaping controls.

Oscillator Texture 2.description: Generates a two-dimensional phase-driven oscillator texture from index values.

PPQ Beat.description: Converts PPQ ticks or beat transport into beat counts, normalized phase and tick triggers.

PPQ Generator.description: Generates musical PPQ ticks, beat transport and phase with play, reset, scrub, tempo and meter controls.

PPQ Meter.description: Converts PPQ or beat transport into bar count, bar phase and bar ticks for a time signature.

PPQ Phasor.description:
Phase-locked ramp synchronized to MIDI clock (PPQ24).
Features frequency modulation (FM) with smooth phase-locking (PLL).
Jump Trigger forces hard-sync for 3 frames.
ResyncTime controls how fast the PLL corrects drift.

PPQ Timeline.description: Provides a dockable musical timeline with transport, meter, looping, jumps and PPQ outputs.

Pad XY.description: XY pad that displays input points with trails and allows interactive control of an output point.

Pan Tilt Editor.description: Edits multiple pan and tilt positions and outputs pan and tilt vectors.

Path Maker.description: Creates a continuous path from input points. Input points define the ordered vertices of the path. The 'Close' parameter connects the last point back to the first point to create a closed figure. Output is compatible with trimPath and other path processing nodes.

Pathway Generator.description: Generates pathways over a matrix of segments by defining the angle of each segment. Angles are normalized 0-1 for 0-360°, -1 represents null values.

Permutations.description: Generates permutations from an input vector based on a given set size. To avoid excessive computations, the input vector size is limited to 12. The sort toggle allows for successive pair swaps between adjacent indexs

Phasor.description:
This module calculates a looping signal.

BPM -> Derived from master BPM.
Div -> Divison of the BPM.
Mult -> Mult of BPM.
Init Ph -> The starting point of the loop.
Reset -> Makes the loop start at the begining.
Loop -> when the loop has ended returns to start if true.
Phase -> The calculated value

Phasor Reset.description: Outputs true while the input phase is nonzero and false when it is zero.

Phasor Swing.description: Adds TR-909 style swing to a phasor input

Piano Keyboard.description: Displays a piano keyboard that highlights keys based on pitch and gate inputs. Click keys to create chords.

Piano Roll.description: A piano roll interface node that outputs note velocities based on user input.

Piano Roll Live.description:
Displays incoming pitch, gate, and velocity vectors as a scrolling live piano roll.
Velocity is shown as dimmer-to-brighter notes in a separate dockable window.

Piano Roll Track.description: Edits and plays timeline note clips, outputting pitch, velocity and gate vectors for active notes.

Pitch Class Load.description: Loads pitch classes and outputs them with optional octave folding.

Pixel Stretch.description: Stretches or samples input pixel values using an X coordinate vector.

Plane Renderer.description:
Creates a textured plane for use in the Equirectangular Pipeline.

**Geometry**

**[ Plane.Width]** Plane width in scene units.

**[ Plane.Height]** Plane height in scene units.

**[ Plane.Columns]** Mesh resolution across the width.

**[ Plane.Rows]** Mesh resolution across the height.

**Texture and transform**

**[ Tex.In]** Optional surface texture. Connect Mesh Out to an Equirectangular Pipeline mesh input to render it.

**[ PosX]** Mesh translation along the scene X axis.

**[ PosY]** Mesh translation along the scene Y axis.

**[ PosZ]** Mesh translation along the scene Z axis.

**[ ScaleX]** Scale multiplier along the mesh X axis.

**[ ScaleY]** Scale multiplier along the mesh Y axis.

**[ ScaleZ]** Scale multiplier along the mesh Z axis.

**[ RotX]** Rotation about the X axis, in degrees.

**[ RotY]** Rotation about the Y axis, in degrees.

**[ RotZ]** Rotation about the Z axis, in degrees.

**[ FlipX]** Mirrors texture coordinates horizontally. Does not mirror the geometry.

**[ FlipY]** Mirrors texture coordinates vertically. Does not mirror the geometry.

**Output**

**[ Mesh Out]** Reference to this mesh for an Equirectangular Pipeline Mesh input. This is a mesh object, not an image texture.

**Notes**

Geometry and transforms use scene units rather than normalized 0-1 coordinates. This node supplies mesh data; the connected pipeline performs rendering.

Point At Pct.description: Samples XY positions along a shape at normalized percentages.

Point Is Present.description:
Keeps entire polyline groups whose coordinates are present in comparison vectors.

**Inputs**

**[ X.In]** X coordinates to check. A -1 splits the input into polyline groups.

**[ Y.In]** Y coordinates to check, paired by index with X.In.

**[ X.Comp]** Reference X values to search for using exact equality.

**[ Y.Comp]** Reference Y values to search for using exact equality.

**Outputs**

**[ X.Out]** X coordinates of groups for which every vertex passes the coordinate tests.

**[ Y.Out]** Y coordinates of the accepted groups.

**[ Found]** One 1 or 0 per input vertex, excluding separators. Every vertex in a group receives the same group result.

**Notes**

X and Y membership are tested independently: matching values may occur at different reference indices. This is not a paired-point or nearest-distance test. Input coordinate lengths must match and contain more than one element; otherwise the previous outputs remain. Evaluates every update.

Point Matrix.description: Generates a rectangular matrix of XY points.

Points Distance.description:
Finds nearest distances and directions between two 2D point sets, with an output entry for every point on each side.

**Coordinate inputs**

**[ x0]** X coordinates of point set 0.

**[ y0]** Y coordinates of point set 0.

**[ x1]** X coordinates of point set 1.

**[ y1]** Y coordinates of point set 1.

**Controls**

**[ Width]** Scale applied to X differences for both distance outputs.

**[ Height]** Scale applied to Y differences for both distance outputs.

**[ Angle Mode]** Blended combines directions from all valid opposite points. Nearest uses only the closest match and is faster.

**[ Interp]** Direction weighting in Blended mode. -1 favors nearby points; +1 approaches equal weighting. Does not change nearest distances or indices.

**Outputs**

**[ Dist0]** Nearest scaled distance for every point in set 0. -1 means no match.

**[ Ang0]** Direction from set 1 toward each point in set 0, in turns: 0 is +X and 0.25 is +Y.

**[ Index0]** Zero-based index of each set-0 point's nearest match in set 1. -1 means no match.

**[ Dist1]** Nearest scaled distance for every point in set 1. -1 means no match.

**[ Ang1]** Direction from set 0 toward each point in set 1, in turns: 0 is +X and 0.25 is +Y.

**[ Index1]** Zero-based index of each set-1 point's nearest match in set 0. -1 means no match.

**Inspector**

**[ Scaled Angles]** Applies Width and Height to direction calculations as well as distances.

**[ Intercalate]** Reverses direction contributions from odd indices in the opposite point set.

**[ Exclude Same Index]** Skips matches with the same index on both sides, useful when comparing a point set with itself.

**Notes**

Within a set, a single X or Y value broadcasts to the other coordinate length. Other length mismatches make that set empty. Non-finite points keep their output slots but cannot match. Missing, coincident or cancelling directions give angle 0. Evaluates on update and reuses unchanged results.

Points Resampler.description: Resamples XY points by a target count or spacing.

Points Resampler Index.description: Resamples XY points and also outputs their corresponding source indices.

Poly Fill.description: Fills a polyphonic structure based on a given input vector. It takes an input and repeats its non-zero elements based on the 'nVoices' and 'Poly Step' parameters. 'nVoices' determines the repetition count, and 'Poly Step' defines the interval between these repeated elements.

Poly Line.description: Builds polyline geometry from XY coordinates, width, stroke color and fill color inputs.

Poly Line Renderer.description: Renders polyline geometry into a texture, optionally using a texture input.

Poly Step Sequencer.description: An multi-track traditional or probabilistic sequencer, capable of storing slots of sequence data. It features adjustable sequence lengths, value ranges, and offset for each track. Responds to phasor input for playback control and provides both individual track outputs and a combined vector output. The vectorial slot system enables switching between different sequence configurations per individual track

Polygon Area.description: Calculates the area of a polygon from its X and Y vertex vectors.

Polygon Creator.description: Generates polygon vertices with side count, closure, translation, scale and rotation controls.

Polygon Perimeter.description: Calculates the perimeter of a polygon from its X and Y vertex vectors.

Polyline Info.description:
Counts vertices, segments and separate polylines in a set of 2D paths.

**Inputs**

**[ In.X]** X coordinate vector. A -1 separates polylines.

**[ In.Y]** Y coordinate vector. A -1 separates polylines.

**Outputs**

**[ Total Points]** Total number of vertices, excluding separators.

**[ Total Segments]** Total number of connections between consecutive vertices within each polyline.

**[ Num Polylines]** Number of non-empty paths.

**[ Segments Per Polyline]** One segment count for each path, in input order.

**[ Vertices Per Polyline]** One vertex count for each path, in input order.

**Notes**

A -1 in either coordinate ends the current path. If the input lengths differ, only their shared portion is read. A path with N vertices has N-1 segments.

Polylines OSC Sender.description: Sends polyline inputs over OSC to a host and port with configurable scan speed.

Polyphonic Arpeggiator.description: Polyphonic arpeggiator with euclidean gating, strum, positive-only deviations (octave, index, chromatic), euclidean accent and duration patterns. Pitch sequence is precomputed from scale and pattern. Each trigger advances one step, toggling gates at the current position with per-voice strum and duration.

Polyphonic Arpeggiator GUI.description: Dockable polyphonic arpeggiator with scale and chord-pool source modes.

Ponk Shape.description: Prepares vector shapes for a Ponk laser sender with speed, blanking, ordering and point repetition controls.

Portal.description: Sends named values within a canvas or across parent and macro canvases when global scope is selected.

Portal Selector.description: Selects a portal of this type and outputs its data. Global portals are marked with *.

Post-It Note.description:
Places a colored annotation directly on the canvas. Click to select, drag to move, and double-click the body to edit text.

**Inspector**

**[ Text]** Note contents. Editing the note updates this value.

**[ Backgr.Color]** Note background color, including alpha.

**[ Text.Color]** Note text color, including alpha.

**[ Font Size]** Text size at normal canvas zoom; scales with the canvas.

**Notes**

Escape or clicking outside ends text editing. Drag the bottom-right corner to resize; the size is saved with the preset. Text is hidden at low zoom while the note remains visible. Corner Radius is currently fixed internally and is not an exposed parameter.

Prepend.description: Prepends a specified string to the input string. Optional space can be added between them

Presence Detector.description:
Detects how much of a camera image is brighter than a pixel threshold, or different from a captured empty background. Output is an occupancy percentage and a debounced Present flag, not the average brightness of only the bright pixels.

Mode 0 Lightness: bright pixels against a dark scene.
Mode 1 Background Difference: capture the empty scene, then compare RGB per pixel.
Pixel Threshold: minimum pixel lightness or RGB difference, 0..1.
On Area % / Off Area %: percentage of the ROI needed to enter or leave Present.
Capture Empty: store the current frame as the reference; keep the area empty.
Mean Lightness: average luminance within the ROI, 0..1.
Coverage %: percentage of ROI pixels above Pixel Threshold.
Mask: white pixels counted as foreground; black pixels ignored.
Inspector: normalized ROI, downsample size, and frame confirmation counts.

Preset Load Trigger.description: Emits a trigger pulse and a void event after a preset has loaded.

Probabilistic Step Sequencer.description: Samples step probabilities at the incoming index using a deterministic seed.

Program Change.description: Sends MIDI program change messages on a selected channel.

Progression.description: Generates numeric progressions from a vector input. Size controls the output length. Any operation can run in item-wise or vector-wise mode. Includes jitter and sorting. StartElement offsets the series index (useful for Fibonacci, Prime, etc.).

Ps Layer.description: Composites two video frame layers with independent opacity and a selectable blend mode.

Quantize.description: Quantizes each value in the input vector to the nearest value specified in the qList vector.

RGB to RGBW.description: Converts RGB color values (normalized 0-1) to RGBW values (normalized 0-1).

RGBW to RGB.description: Converts RGBW color values (normalized 0-1) back to RGB values (normalized 0-1).

ROI Warp.description: Warps an input texture using an editable region of interest and configurable output dimensions.

ROI Warp Display.description: Displays and routes ROI warp textures using named inputs and outputs.

ROTO-Control Config.description: Configure ROTO-CONTROL knobs, switches, and setups. Set names, colors, MIDI channels, CC numbers, and step counts for each control across multiple pages. Manage device setups for different configurations.

Radial Indexer.description: Creates radial index patterns similar to Indexer Texture 2 but outputs vector data

Radial Modulation.description: Modulates XY points radially or rotationally around a configurable center.

Radio Station VLC.description: VLC-based radio station with multi-channel output routing

Ramp.description: Generates a linear ramp from 0 to 1 over a specified duration in milliseconds. By default it runs independently of playback. With Sync To Transport enabled, it follows transport play/pause and frame-stepped rendering.

RampTrigger.description: Generates a timed ramp when triggered, with duration in milliseconds.

Random Element Selector.description:
Draws a new weighted random selection from a vector whenever Trigger fires.

**Inputs and controls**

**[ Input]** Source values to sample. Selection operates on indices, so equal values at different indices can both be selected.

**[ Weights]** Relative probability per input index. Short vectors repeat their last weight; an empty vector uses 1. Supply no more weights than input elements.

**[ Num Elements]** Requested output size. With Unrepeated enabled, it is capped to the input length.

**[ Unrepeated]** Prevents selecting the same index twice within a draw. Indices used in the previous draw get one tenth of their normal weight, but can still reappear.

**[ Trigger]** Creates a new selection using the current inputs and controls.

**Output**

**[ Output]** Selected values in draw order. With Unrepeated disabled, the same input index can appear multiple times.

**Notes**

Input or control edits do not select again until Trigger fires. Previous-draw avoidance is a preference, not a guarantee.

Random Generator.description: Generates discreate values when Phasor changed from < 0.5 to > 0.5

Random Osc Texture.description: Generates phase-driven random oscillation in a texture using input indices.

Random Oscillator.description: Generates smooth interpolated random values with a periodicity based on phasor

Random Series.description: This module generates consistent random number series based on provided seeds. Each series' length and the index of its output are defined by the 'length' and 'index' inputs, respectively. The 'Q' input quantizes the series values, with 'Int' toggling integer output and 'Urn' ensuring non-repeated values

Random Values.description: Generates a vector of random values when 'Generate' is triggered. Seed 0 is non-deterministic; a non-zero Seed produces a repeatable sequence that restarts when the Seed changes.

Ranged Slider.description: A range slider with two handles for min/max values, outputs vector<float> with size 2.

Ranger.description: Same as mapper but for non normalized values

Rate Limiter.description: Limits how often input changes are forwarded, using a minimum interval in milliseconds.

Reaper OSC Transport.description: Receives REAPER OSC transport state, tempo, beat and time position, and derives PPQ outputs.

ReaperOSC.description:
Reads the latest stored value for one REAPER OSC channel from the shared ReaperOSC controller.

**Control**

**[ Id]** Channel identifier to read, from 1 to 512.

**Output**

**[ Out]** Most recently received float for the selected channel, published on each update. The controller initializes channels to -1 before data arrives.

**Notes**

The shared controller listens on UDP port 12349. Configure the sender to match the controller's REAPER OSC address layout; this node does not send OSC.

Reindexer.description: Rearanges a vector with the defined indices in the Indexs parameter. If a not exact position is given, it linearly interpolates between the closest

Remove -1.description: Removes separator values of -1 from input point or value vectors.

Repeater FX.description: Repeats video frames using loop, beat timing, gate and speed controls.

Rising Edge Reindexer.description: Tracks rising edges (0 to non-zero transitions) in the input vector and outputs indices in order of activation. When a value returns to 0, its position becomes available for new rising edges while maintaining positions of other active values.

Risset.description: Endless rising or falling glissando: pitch and linear amplitude vectors for N voices. Driven by a phasor: one cycle moves every voice by one interval, backwards falls. Quantize snaps the pitches to Scale (pitch classes, 0 = C); Equal Loudness weights the amplitudes by an equal-loudness curve.

Router.description: Exposes an input or output value between a macro and its parent canvas.

SC.description: Runs a SuperCollider synthesis or processing node; available pins depend on its synth definition.

SC A2k.description: Converts SuperCollider audio inputs to control values.

SC AdditiveBox.description: Polyphonic additive synth: up to 256 partials per voice from two morphing spectra, each partial with its own envelope, filter gain, sweep, mask, vibrato, noise, blur and place among the outputs (Voices and Outputs are independent), unison / harmonizer, a modulation envelope and two LFOs, EQ / echo / reverb. Show opens the spectrum and every control; right-click a control there to publish it to the node.

SC ArpeggiatorBox.description: Polyphonic arpeggiator played sample accurately: a scale or a chord pool, patterns, polyphony, bass, euclidean / random / step accents and long notes, strum, swing, chances and seeded randomness. Clock: the transport, its own clock or triggers (a bang or an audio cable). Trig, Gate (x velocity) and Pitch outputs per voice, and for the bass. Show opens the piano roll and every control; right-click a control there to type a value or publish it here.

SC BeatRepeat Pro.description: Coherent multichannel beat repeater with a live waveform, loop region and read/write heads.

SC BeatTracker.description: Tracks beats in SuperCollider audio and outputs quarter, eighth, sixteenth and tempo signals.

SC Buffer.description: Loads and selects SuperCollider audio buffers and exposes duration, sample rate and embedding controls.

SC Buffer Allocator.description: Allocates SuperCollider recording buffers with channel count, length and circular recording controls.

SC Buffer Browser.description: Browses SuperCollider buffers and outputs the selected buffer.

SC Channel Router Matrix.description: Routes multichannel audio through an interactive channel matrix with bypass and compensation options.

SC Chord.description: Edits chord pitches and outputs note names with optional octave folding.

SC Code.description: Plays SuperCollider code pasted from anywhere: Compile runs it without a server and keeps every SynthDef it builds. Audio bus controls (In.ar(\in), Out.ar(\out)) become ports, every other control a parameter. A SynthDef that frees itself plays polyphonic voices from the Gate lanes. Promote turns the tested code into a regular Oceanode SynthDef node.

SC Convolution.description: Processes audio through convolution using an impulse-response file with wet level and tone controls.

SC Custom Buffer.description: Converts float vector data into SuperCollider buffer data. Includes temporal lag filtering to reduce artifacts from 60fps control rate updates. Buffer size is fixed at 1024 samples per buffer.

SC DataBox.description: Plays any file as audio: its bytes are decoded into samples and scanned by one playhead per channel. Open the window (Show) to pick the file, the region and how the bytes are read.

SC DynGen.description: Live-coding EEL2 DSP node. Loads DynGen code, exposes dynamic parameters from //@param annotations, and supports fixed-channel multichannel DSP scripts.

SC DynGen Poly.description: Mono-authored DynGen node that runs one independent script instance per channel while keeping vector-addressable parameters in Oceanode.

SC EchoBox.description: Multi-tap echo: each tap with its own time (ms or beats), feedback, filter, diffusion that grows with every repeat, saturation, shimmer, ping-pong across the channels, wow and freeze; then SpaceMaster reverb on the echoes and ducking. Show opens the editor with the echo map; right-click a control there to publish it to the node.

SC EuclideanBox.description: Euclidean sequencer locked to the transport: up to 8 tracks of hits spread over steps, with euclidean accents and long notes, swing, chance and a pitch progression over a scale. Seeded randomization every N cycles / bars / beats. Each track has Trig, Gate and Pitch outputs (Gate carries the hit's level), Voices channels wide (round robin or all voices). Show opens the rings, the timeline and every control; right-click a control there to type a value or publish it here.

SC FFT.description: Analyzes SuperCollider audio and displays its frequency spectrum with smoothing and logarithmic display options.

SC FFT HD.description: Displays a high-resolution frequency spectrum of SuperCollider audio with smoothing and dB controls.

SC Fast Envelope Follower.description: Follows multichannel audio amplitude with attack, release and polling controls, optionally generating binary gates.

SC Freezer.description: Freezes the main SuperCollider server by stopping OSC messages.

SC GrainBox.description: Processes audio with a granular sampling engine and integrated echo and reverb, with optional transport synchronization.

SC GrainSamplerGui.description: Provides a granular buffer sampler with trigger, position, grain size, speed, jitter and gain controls.

SC Graphic EQ.description: Processes audio through a multiband equalizer with band gain, frequency, slope and Q controls and a dockable editor.

SC Info.description: Reports SuperCollider audio amplitudes, peaks and control values with lag and decay controls.

SC MetroBox.description: Generative rhythm locked to the transport: up to 8 lanes, each with its own cycle (polymeter), generator (Grid, Euclidean, Weighted durations, Subdivision, Markov), metric rules, phrases (form, fills, build-ups), ornaments, groove and relations to the lanes above. Evolve them with Mutate / Re-roll / Keep / Undo / Like / crossover. Each lane has mono Trig, Gate and Amp outputs. Seeded per cycle, so the window previews exactly what will play. Open it with Show; right-click a control there to type a value or publish it here.

SC Mixer Pro.description: Multichannel, multi-server mixer: each track runs on its own server, one output per server. Dockable mixer window with VU / peak, fader, balance, mute / solo; per strip HP, EQ, DC, compressor, saturation, echo and reverb; aux sends to return strips; master HP, EQ, maximizer and limiter (every effect costs nothing until switched on).

SC MultiTrack Rec.description: Records N audio inputs simultaneously to separate WAV files

SC NRT Recorder.description: Renders SuperCollider audio offline to a file with channel, master and parallel-render controls.

SC Output.description: Routes SuperCollider audio to output channels on a selected server with an optional delay in milliseconds.

SC Pink Trombone.description: Generates vocal synthesis using the Pink Trombone vocal-tract model with constriction and frication controls.

SC Pitch.description: Edits pitch values and outputs note names with optional octave folding.

SC PitchTracker.description: Tracks pitch from SuperCollider audio inputs and outputs pitch estimates; available outputs depend on the addon implementation.

SC Poly Arpeggiator AR.description: SC polyphonic arpeggiator — audio-rate trigger input, audio-rate gate/pitch/velocity/duration outputs per voice. Scale, pattern and euclidean data are pre-computed in C++ and uploaded to the SynthDef. Timing-critical logic (step counter, gate envelopes, strum) runs in SuperCollider. Inspector 'Sync To Transport': the step clock follows the global transport ((beat + Beat Offset) * Div steps) instead of the Trig input; Trig and Reset are then ignored.

SC PolyMixerTrack.description: Mixes multiple multichannel SuperCollider tracks with gain, balance, master level and a dockable mixer.

SC PulsarBox.description: Pulsar synthesis: every voice emits pulses at its Fundamental (a rhythm below ~20 Hz, a pitch above), each holding 1..4 formant layers (a pulsaret table at the formant frequency under an envelope Cycles long). Masking (probability, burst / rest, sieve), per-pulse output routing and jitter; nuPG tables. Show opens the pulse train, the spectrum and every control; right-click a control there to publish it to the node.

SC RAVE.description: RAVE neural timbre transfer (nn.ar). Load a .ts model; the channel count follows the model.

SC Rhythm Box.description: Provides a multitrack rhythm sequencer with sample slots, per-step probability, filter and volume controls.

SC SampleBox.description: Sampler for one audio file: trigger or gate it (Oceanode values or an audio signal), one-shot / loop / gated, resample or time stretch, reverse, up to 8 voices, envelopes and LFOs routed to its parameters, filter, EQ, compressor, saturator and reverb. Show opens the editor; right-click a control there to publish it.

SC SimpleSamplePlayer.description: Plays a SuperCollider audio buffer with a gain control.

SC SlicerBox.description: Cuts an audio file into slices (a grid or its transients) and plays each slice from its own lane of the Gate vector: Oceanode vectors or an audio-rate gate. Each slice is one-shot or gated, with its own pitch and direction; an EQ on the output. Show opens the waveform, the pads and every control; right-click a control there to publish it to the node.

SC SpectralFilterBox.description: Spectral filter drawn by a float vector of any size (e.g. a Manual Vector): the vector lies over log frequency (Low Hz .. High Hz) as the gain of every FFT bin; Circular XFade blends its two ends into each other so it scrolls round without a step. Transpose, Scroll and Spread move it in semitones (per channel with Spread). Shaping (interpolation, contrast, blur, steps, invert, dB range) and the per-bin attack / release / hold are in the inspector. Custom UGen PV_MaskFilter, about 0.5% CPU per channel. Mode Bandpass: the same filter from a bank of bandpasses, without the FFT's latency (64 or 128 bands).

SC Spectrogram.description: Displays SuperCollider audio frequency history as a spectrogram texture with smoothing, speed and colormap controls.

SC SuperFM.description: Generates FM synthesis voices with a modulation matrix, presets, pitch, gate, vibrato and tremolo controls.

SC SuperFMDrone.description: Generates continuous FM drone synthesis with a modulation matrix, presets, pitch and modulation controls.

SC TestNoise.description: Generates a SuperCollider test noise signal for checking audio routing.

SC Timeline Wave Track.description: Plays a timeline wave track through SuperCollider with volume and playback-rate controls.

SC VST.description: Hosts VST instruments and effects in SuperCollider with plugin selection, editor, program and MIDI note controls.

SC VUMeter.description: Displays multichannel audio levels with attack, release, peak and display controls.

SC VelvetReverb.description: Applies velvet-noise reverberation with wet level, decay, brightness, damping and filtering controls.

SC Wavetable.description: Wavetable oscillator (Serum / Vital / AKWF tables, or a folder of single cycles) with position, 2D grid, phase warps and FM, band-limited at any pitch. Show opens the waterfall view and every control; right-click a control there to publish it to the node.

SC analogBox.description: Polyphonic subtractive synth. Up to 6 band-limited morphing oscillators (the LFOs' width / skew / round shape at audio rate) with sync and FM, noise, ring, an SVF or ladder filter (2 / 4 poles, drive, saturation, feedback), envelopes, LFOs and a modulation matrix, spread over the speakers, then sine shaper, saturation, ring mod, chorus, EQ, echo and reverb. Show opens the editor; right-click a control there to publish or modulate it.

SC polycombBox.description: Polyphonic comb-resonator synth. Gate takes Oceanode values and audio-rate gates together. Oscillators with FM, filters, comb, ring mod, sine shaper, envelopes, LFOs and a modulation matrix, spread over the speakers, then EQ, echo and reverb. Built from small synths: only the parts in use run. Show opens the editor; right-click a control there to publish it.

SVG 2 Texture.description: Loads and renders SVG artwork into a texture and exposes geometry and object count.

SVG Modulator.description: Loads SVG geometry and modulates its shapes, outputting XY vectors.
